newsitem.title: USA: Metromedia sees Q3 gain from segment sale.
newsitem.headline: Metromedia sees Q3 gain from segment sale.

text.p: Metromedia International Group Inc, which earlier Friday reported a second-quarter loss, said it expects to post a unspecified third-quarter gain on the sale of its discontinued Entertainment Group segment.

The company said its operating results reflect the reclassification of the operations of the Entertainment Group as a discontinued operation based on the sale of most of its entertainment assets on July 10, 1997.

Revenues for the three months ended June 30, 1997, were $63,770,000, compared with revenues of $2,775,000 a year ago. The company reported an operating loss for the 1997 second quarter of $17,504,000, compared with an operating loss of $10,645,000. The net loss for the 1997 second quarter was $72,966,000, or a loss of $1.10 per common share, compared with a net loss of $18,850,000, or a loss of $0.44 per common share.

The 1997 second quarter net loss includes $25,263,000 and $2,422,000 attributable to discontinued operations for the three months ended June 30, 1997, and 1996, respectively, and equity in losses of and a writedown of the inventory in RDM Sports Group Inc. totaling $26,216,000 for the three months ended June 30, 1997.
